NPU03577 (P-Thyrotropin) is a specific laboratory test code used within the Danish healthcare system to identify and track measurements of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) [^src1]. In the context of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), managed by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), this code serves as a critical clinical quality indicator for cardiovascular care [^src1]. 

The primary significance of NPU03577 lies in its use for monitoring diagnostic follow-up in patients with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. The database uses this specific code to calculate the proportion of newly diagnosed patients who undergo a TSH measurement within a strictly defined clinical timeframe: from 60 days prior to, up to 30 days following, their initial date of diagnosis [^src1]. By standardizing the exact code used for TSH measurement, the RKKP ensures consistent data collection, enabling reliable comparisons of diagnostic quality and adherence to clinical guidelines across different Danish regions [^src1].
